global_requirements.verified_item_rule: Every verified item requires a generator, output, deterministic provenance sidecar, authorized claim IDs, accepted evidence manifest, and manuscript binding.
global_requirements.source_control: Scientific inputs must be committed; generated paper sources and sidecars remain trackable for the later integration commit.
global_requirements.identity: Sidecars bind generator, manifest, committed inputs, output SHA-256, evidence revision, and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.
global_requirements.determinism: No wall-clock timestamp or machine-dependent path is permitted in generated source or sidecars.
global_requirements.uncertainty: Intervals must identify estimator, level, sample count, seeds, and included uncertainty components.
global_requirements.failure_accounting: Excluded, failed, censored, and out-of-domain evaluations must be counted.
global_requirements.gate_rule: Planned items cannot become verified until every required result gate and evidence manifest passes.
